report_name: GitLab Patches Critical Integer Overflow Vulnerability

vulnerabilities.name: Integer Overflow in Regular Expression Compiler
vulnerabilities.description: A critical-severity integer overflow vulnerability in GitLab's regular expression compiler. This flaw could be triggered by crafted input, potentially leading to denial-of-service or arbitrary code execution.

vulnerabilities.name: Improper Authentication in OmniAuth-to-LDAP Auto-linking
vulnerabilities.description: A high-severity improper authentication vulnerability related to how user accounts are linked when using OmniAuth with an LDAP backend. This could potentially lead to account takeover or privilege escalation.

indicators.name: GitLab Regex Compiler Crash Detection
indicators.pattern:
title: GitLab Regex Compiler Crash Detection
id: 2b9c7d8e-1a3f-4b6c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects an unusual number of errors or crashes related to regex processing in GitLab's production.log, which may indicate attempts to trigger the integer overflow vulnerability.
references:
  - https://about.gitlab.com/releases/2026/10/21/security-release-gitlab-19-5-1-released/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-22
tags:
  - attack.t1499
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: application
  product: gitlab
detection:
  keywords:
    - 'RegexpError'
    - 'integer overflow in regexp'
    - 'stack level too deep in regexp'
  condition: keywords
indicators.description: Detects an unusual number of errors or crashes related to regex processing in GitLab's production.log, which may indicate attempts to trigger the integer overflow vulnerability.

indicators.name: GitLab Suspicious LDAP Authentication
indicators.pattern:
title: GitLab Suspicious LDAP Authentication
id: 8e1d2c3b-4a5f-6b7c-8d9e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects unexpected or suspicious authentication events in GitLab's audit_json.log related to OmniAuth and LDAP, which could indicate abuse of the improper authentication vulnerability.
references:
  - https://about.gitlab.com/releases/2026/10/21/security-release-gitlab-19-5-1-released/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-22
tags:
  - attack.t1078
  - attack.privilege_escalation
level: high
logsource:
  category: application
  product: gitlab
detection:
  selection:
    # These are hypothetical fields for a GitLab audit_json.log
    meta.auth_type: 'omniauth'
    author.name|contains: 'ldap'
    details.message|contains:
      - 'failed to link'
      - 'improper authentication'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects unexpected or suspicious authentication events in GitLab's audit_json.log related to OmniAuth and LDAP, which could indicate abuse of the improper authentication vulnerability.

relationships.target_name: Integer Overflow in Regular Expression Compiler
